notes: Round-1 scenarios. Inputs use emulator.input {buttons:[...],port:1} (button/pressed params are silently ignored on NES, see TK-001). Durable snapshots: traces/round01/*.snap.gz (same-build romatlas snapshots; gunzip then emulator.snapshot.import). Tracing was aggregate-only (capacity 0, all kinds); coverage/contexts/edges dumps in traces/round01/*.json.gz. Frame counts are approximate where noted; routes are replayable by the listed button sequences.
